hot.title: "When the ship is sinking, you don't compare buckets."
hot.meta: Jake · Instagram reel (20s) · Sat Nov 14, 17:31 ET
why: It's the most-engaged post on Instagram, the platform with the most organic report leads this week: 86 engagements (39 likes, 42 shares, 4 comments, 1 save) on 1,940 views, a 4.43% engagement rate.
